chronology.reason: The entire recipe/IR pivot is uncommitted. This hash proves only current internal consistency, not that the protocol predates any future measurement.
chronology.activationRequirement: A future explicitly authorized commit must contain this exact protocol before any v3 Figma write or capture.

implementationDependencies.meaning: Current uncommitted bytes required by a future authorized v3 run; hashes prove dependency identity only, never chronology.

requirements: typed variable bindings with compatible target properties
actual adornment text and asset payload integrity
state-appropriate fill, stroke, effect, and visibility
scene-derived expected-plan accounting with zero missing, extra, mismatched, duplicate-collapsed, or unobserved facts
scene-derived two-cycle fixed point without source IR readback
no clipping beyond the locked threshold
no semantic-role overlap beyond the locked threshold

dimensionError.failureRule: absolute error exceeds 4px and relative error exceeds 8%

spacingError.failureRule: absolute error exceeds 4px and relative error exceeds 20%

readbackAndAccounting.expectedDenominatorGenerated: before live execution from the compiled writer plan

overallRequirements: recipe aggregate geometry error is lower than legacy
recipe aggregate perceptual error is lower than legacy
recipe aggregate combined perceptual-and-ink error is lower than legacy
visualRelativeProgression.stratumSafeguard: No source, state, or adornment stratum may materially regress relative to unchanged legacy.

historicalApplication.reason: V2 has incorrect adornment content and a regressing MUI pixel/ink stratum. Aggregate improvement cannot waive either hard failure.
